# noqeri/html 0.5.0

HTML URL-attribute scheme gates and bounded class-token policies (not a substitute for HTML escaping or CSP).

The 0.1.1 exports are retained. License: MIT. This version is experimental until compiled and executed with the native Noqeri SDK. Host integration and OS-level safety are not implied by byte-level guards.

See `src/html.noqeri`, and `tests/depth_regression.noqeri`.
